ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure is a two-input buck-type power supply circuit. On the left side there are two DC voltage sources, labeled 10 V and 5 V respectively; the upper switch S1 connects the 10 V source through a diode to the common switching node, and the lower switch S2 connects the 5 V source through a diode to the same common node. This node then passes through inductor L to the output terminal, and the output terminal has capacitor C and load resistor RL connected in parallel, with output voltage V0 marked across RL. Reasoning: Since at any instant only one of S1 or S2 is conducting, and according to the problem statement the inductor current is continuous and the capacitor voltage ripple can be ignored, volt-second balance can be used for the inductor. During the 0.2 ms when S1 is conducting, the left end of the inductor is approximately 10 V, so the inductor voltage is 10 - V0. During the 0.3 ms when S2 is conducting, the left end of the inductor is approximately 5 V, so the inductor voltage is 5 - V0. Within one period T = 0.5 ms, the average inductor voltage is zero: (10 - V0)(0.2 ms) + (5 - V0)(0.3 ms) = 0. Expanding gives 2 + 1.5 - 0.5V0 = 0, so 0.5V0 = 3.5, V0 = 7 V.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify the converter as a two-input buck-like supply: when S1 is ON, the inductor input node is clamped to 10 V; when S2 is ON, it is clamped to 5 V. From the text, use t1 = 0.2 ms, t2 = 0.3 ms, and T = 0.5 ms. Apply inductor volt-second balance: (10 - V0)(0.2 ms) + (5 - V0)(0.3 ms) = 0. Solve for V0 = [10(0.2) + 5(0.3)] / 0.5 = 7 V.

图像描述：附图是一个两输入降压型供电电路。左侧有两个直流电压源，分别标为 10 V 和 5 V；上方开关 S1 将 10 V 源经二极管接到公共开关节点，下方开关 S2 将 5 V 源经二极管接到同一公共节点。该节点再经过电感 L 接到输出端，输出端并联电容 C 和负载电阻 RL，RL 两端标出输出电压 V0。

(10 - V0)(0.2 ms) + (5 - V0)(0.3 ms) = 0。
展开得 2 + 1.5 - 0.5V0 = 0，所以 0.5V0 = 3.5，V0 = 7 V。
